similarities.label: Similarities
similarities.when: to show two things are alike

phrases.t: They have a great deal in common, namely …

phrases.connector: …, so it is fair to say that …

phrases.t: What they both have in common is …
There is a clear parallel between … and …
phrases.connector: …, since both …, and as a result …

phrases.t: Neither of them was very different.
Either you get this one or that one.

similarities.convention: Both / neither / either / each govern singular and plural agreement differently — a frequent Use of English item as well as a writing error.

tasks.question: What do city life and country life have in common?

cues.cue: city life / country life / offer community
models: Both city life and country life offer a sense of community.

tasks.question: In what ways are online learning and classroom learning alike?

models: What online and classroom learning have in common is that both need discipline.

tasks.question: What do reading and travelling have in common as ways of learning?

models: In much the same way as travelling, reading broadens the mind.

tasks.question: In what ways are TV and social media similar?

models: Similarly, both TV and social media entertain people.

tasks.question: What do all successful students seem to have in common?

models: There is a clear parallel between all successful students: they work hard.

tasks.question: In what ways are studying abroad and studying at home alike?

models: Just as buses do, trains carry many people at once.
